versions.changelog:
- Clarified that all image URLs (view, download, thumbnail) must be taken exactly from the API response; do not construct URLs manually.
- Updated documentation to reflect that the API now includes ready-to-use `viewUrl` and `downloadUrl` fields for each image.
- Revised descriptions and instructions for presenting generated images, emphasizing the use of direct API-provided links.
- Adjusted daily AI image generation limits messaging to state up to 240 free AI images per day.
- Updated the skill description for clarity on API access, quotas, and usage requirements.

No code or documentation changes detected in this release.

- Version number updated to 1.0.3.
- No functional or documentation changes present.

**New in version 1.1.0: Adds AI image generation and smart suggestions.**

- Introduced custom AI image generation when no existing images match a search.
- Added automatic smart search suggestions, including related images and alternative keywords, when no results are found.
- Implemented feedback collection for image search and generation experiences.
- Clearly present generation quota and inform users of remaining free generations per day.
- Updated response formatting to include new handling for generated images and suggestions.

- Added requirement to include source=clawhub in all API requests for analytics tracking.
- Updated example API requests to include the source=clawhub parameter.
- Added section for retrieving site statistics using the /api/public/stats endpoint.
- No changes to core functionality or response handling.

Initial release of NK Images Search with instant access to 1M+ AI-generated stock photos.

- Search over 1 million high-quality, AI-generated stock images across 235+ niches.
- No API key required; all searches are free and open.
- Easily filter by niche, category, orientation, and more using simple search parameters.
- Get clear results with image name, description, size, full image link, and NK Images page.
- Supports helpful, user-friendly interactions and suggestions for refining searches.
